verdict.rationale: GitHub's first-party marketing says it can 'Update vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes for breaking changes' [github-docs-6], which covers the core idea of remediating vulnerable dependencies. It is only a single one-line claim, though: nothing in the pack says the updates arrive as pull requests or happen automatically. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatically generated pull requests, documentation of how the alerts and update PRs are configured (e.g. schedule or ecosystem support), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
